lessons.title: Define Classes Constructors
lessons.description: Constructors initialize new objects. Define a Car class with make and year fields and getters. The test checks that !"Toyota".equals(c.getMake()) || c.getYear() equals 2022; c.getMake( equals "Toyota".
learning_objectives: This step stores the constructor argument on the object, using Bag holding grove.

tests.name: test_car
tests.test_code: Car c = new Car("Toyota", 2022); if (!"Toyota".equals(c.getMake()) || c.getYear() != 2022) throw new AssertionError("Expected Toyota 2022");

lessons.title: Practice Instance Methods State
lessons.description: Add instance methods that alter or inspect object state. Implement BankAccount with deposit and withdraw. The test checks that acc.getBalance() is about 150.0.
learning_objectives: This step adds to the object's own charge, using Meter and 32.

tests.name: test_deposit
tests.test_code: BankAccount acc = new BankAccount(100.0); acc.deposit(50.0); if (Math.abs(acc.getBalance() - 150.0) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 150.0");

lessons.title: Practice Student Gradebook
lessons.description: Student is an encapsulated record: private name and score fields set by the constructor. Implement isPassing() to return true when this.score >= 60. The test creates new Student("Ada", 85) and expects isPassing() == true.
learning_objectives: This step averages two scores on the gradebook, using Book and 10.

tests.name: test_passing
tests.test_code: Student s = new Student("Ada", 85); if (!s.isPassing()) throw new AssertionError("Ada passes");
